messages:
sre_ana: Observability alert — multiple control-plane heartbeats missing in eu-west2 across clusters (api-server 0/3, controller-manager crashloop). Sudden 5xx spike. I'm opening channel and paging infra.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: region=eu-west2 — cluster-heartbeat-loss. Pager: sre_ana, infra_kai. Link: <pager/redwood/1998765432>
infra_kai: Checking provider console and network plane now. VPC seems reachable from outside. Kicking off `kubectl get nodes -A -o wide`.
eng_jordan: Paste:
```shell
$ kubectl get nodes
NAME               STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
eu-w2-node-1       NotReady   <none>   11d   v1.28.3
eu-w2-node-2       NotReady   <none>   11d   v1.28.3
eu-w2-node-3       NotReady   <none>   11d   v1.28.3
```
infra_kai: Kubelet logs show repeated OOM/eviction then `hung_task` kernel messages. Looks like OS-level freeze/hang rather than kubelet only.
eng-sre-ross: Service impact: generation-proxy and proxy-gateway returning 502/504s from eu-west2. No global failover happened yet.
ops_miguel: We should shift traffic off eu-west2 immediately. Plan: fail over to eu-west1 + us-west1. Warm up reserved capacity in eu-west1, bring up spot pool in us-west1. Start gradual route shift if LBs report healthy.
infra_kai: Preparing routing command and capacity ops. Proposed command: `routectl shift --from eu-west2 --to=eu-west1,us-west1 --strategy=weight --target-weight=0,70,30 --grace=10m --health-check=/healthz`.
eng_jordan: Also seeing KV cache degradation — cache-store replicas on eu-west2 are flapping. Might need to enable read-only cache proxy in other regions to reduce recompute.
ops_miguel: Actions I kicked: enabling cache-only mode for embeddings and promoting smaller model variants for latency-critical endpoints (`modelctl promote my-model@v1.3-q4_0`). That should lower GPU memory and speed up spin-ups.
pm_lena: How many customers are pinned to eu-west2? Any Dedicated customers affected? Need comms if SLA windows impacted.
infra_kai: Opening provider support ticket (EW2-47321) — reported kernel panic traces on hypervisors. Provider acknowledged and assigned to infra team. ETA unknown.
eng-sre-ross: Kicking global LB config now. Uploading new weights:
```yaml
- region: eu-west2
  weight: 0
- region: eu-west1
  weight: 70
- region: us-west1
  weight: 30
```
health check targets: /_healthz on proxies. Monitoring for 5m sliding window.
ops_miguel: Warm-up scripts fired: spinning up 8 reserved g4dn-equivalents in eu-west1, 12 spot instances in us-west1, priming model caches. Note: this will increase billing — but keep availability priority.
pm_lena: Drafting customer comms now. Will send to infra for wording review before post in status.redwood.ai.
sre_ana: Oncall escalation rule: if nodes not recovered in 15m escalate to oncall-2. Assigning infra_kai as incident lead for now. Please add remediation steps to the incident doc: <internal/incidents/1998765432/triage>
infra_kai: Provider says hypervisor team sees host-level kernel hangs correlating with a recent host OS patch. Rolling host remediation in progress but slow; they recommend evacuating instances now.
eng_jordan: Starting evacuation: `providerctl evacuate --region eu-west2 --filter=eu-w2-node-* --target-pool=eu-west1-reserved` — will notify if any stuck volumes.
ops_miguel: Traffic shift in progress. Initial success: 65% traffic now served from eu-west1, 30% us-west1, 5% still hitting eu-west2 health checks. Error rate trending down but still elevated.
pm_lena: Comms ready: will notify impacted customers in 30m if degradation persists. Include mitigation steps and ETA unknown from provider.
sre_ana: Update: assigning infra_kai as incident lead and eng-sre-ross as routing lead. Postmortem required. Keep monitoring dashboards and update incident doc. :rotating_light:
